name: Alhaitham
title: Admonishing Instruction
description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

skills.name: Abductive Reasoning
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Universality: An Elaboration on Form
skills.description:
Rushes forward, dealing Dendro DMG to nearby opponents when the rush ends, causing a Chisel-Light Mirror to form.
Holding this skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enters Aiming Mode to adjust the direction of Alhaitham's rush attack.

Chisel-Light Mirror
When this skill is unleashed, Alhaitham will generate 1 Chisel-Light Mirror. If there are no Mirrors at this time, he will generate 1 additional Mirror. Chisel-Light Mirrors will have the following properties:
·When he possesses Chisel-Light Mirrors, Alhaitham's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Dendro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
·When attacks of the aforementioned kind hit opponents, the Chisel-Light Mirrors will unleash a Projection Attack that deals AoE Dendro DMG based on the number of Mirrors on the field.
·A total of 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors can exist at once.
·The Chisel-Light Mirrors will disappear one after the other over time, and will all disappear when Alhaitham leaves the field.
skills.info: "Truth inherently exists amidst uncertainty. Even the greatest of scholars are not immune to error."

skills.name: Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena
skills.description:
Creates a Particular Binding Field and deals multiple instances of AoE Dendro DMG.
If Chisel-Light Mirrors exist when this ability is unleashed, all such Mirrors will be consumed and increase the number of DMG instances dealt.
2s after this ability is unleashed, if 0/1/2/3 Mirrors were consumed, Alhaitham will generate 3/2/1/0 new Mirrors in turn.
skills.info: "If a researcher makes wisdom their goal, then they should be prepared to make an enemy of every word they read. Only then can they avoid bias."

passives.name: Four-Causal Correction
passives.description: When Alhaitham's Charged or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, they will generate 1 Chisel-Light Mirror. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

passives.name: Mysteries Laid Bare
passives.description:
Each point of Alhaitham's Elemental Mastery will increase the DMG dealt by Projection Attacks and Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena by 0.1%.
The DMG of both aforementioned abilities can be increased by a maximum of 100% this way.

passives.name: Law of Reductive Overdetermination
passives.description: When Alhaitham crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

constellations.name: Intuition
constellations.description: When a Projection Attack hits an opponent, Universality: An Elaboration on Form's CD is decreased by 1.2s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

constellations.name: Debate
constellations.description: When Alhaitham generates a Chisel-Light Mirror, his Elemental Mastery will be increased by 50 for 8 seconds, max 4 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently. This effect can be triggered even when the maximum number of Chisel-Light Mirrors has been reached.

constellations.name: Negation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Universality: An Elaboration on Form by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Elucidation
constellations.description:
When Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena is unleashed, the following effects will become active based on the number of Chisel-Light Mirrors consumed and created this time around:
·Each Mirror consumed will increase the Elemental Mastery of all other nearby party members by 30 for 15s.
·Each Mirror generated will grant Alhaitham a 10% Dendro DMG Bonus for 15s.

The pre-existing duration of the aforementioned effects will be cleared if you use Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena again while they are in effect.

constellations.name: Sagacity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Structuration
constellations.description:
Alhaitham gains the following effects:
· 2 seconds after Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena is unleashed, he will generate 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors regardless of the number of mirrors consumed.
· If Alhaitham generates Chisel-Light Mirrors when their numbers have already maxed out, his CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 10% and 70% respectively for 6s. If this effect is triggered again during its initial duration, the duration remaining will be increased by 6s.

outfits.name: The Rational
outfits.description:
Alhaitham's outfit. "Don't bother the Scribe with trivialities... What do you think those soundproofers of his are for, anyway?"
So observed an experienced staff member at the Temple of Silence.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: I'm Alhaitham, the Akademiya's scribe. If you wish to access an archived file, please submit an application according to the prescribed format.\nOh, your form isn't ready? Not to worry. You can come again on the next working day. My work hours are posted outside the office.

voices.title: Chat: Work
voices.text: The scribe's work is simple, which is exactly why I took the position.

voices.title: Chat: Reading
voices.text: Book learning alone is not enough to cultivate intelligence. All those scholars in the Akademiya are prime examples.

voices.title: Chat: Thinking
voices.text: Hmm, there have been many poorly written applications lately. I guess I'll just have to reject them all.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Going out on a rainy day is the worst.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: It's just a natural phenomenon, so there's nothing to be afraid of... unless you're beneath a tree.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: It's getting cold, you say? I feel fine.

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: This weather is perfect for doing nothing at all.

voices.title: In the Desert
voices.text: Curses, there's sand in my shoes.

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: It's a little early for me... Let me get a cup of coffee first.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: If there's nothing to do, then I'll just put on my soundproof earpieces and nap for a while.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: I'll be taking some time for myself now. Goodbye.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: I hope my roommate won't be hammering away on another one of his projects in the dead of night... Actually, I'd prefer if he wasn't home at all. I really don't want to wear my soundproof earpieces to bed.

voices.title: About Alhaitham: Facts
voices.text: Rather than lacing my words with rhetoric, I prefer speaking factually.

voices.title: About Alhaitham: Rumors
voices.text: Oh? You're concerned about all the rumors you've heard about me?\nDon't bother, because I don't care whether you believe those rumors. Just don't throw extra trouble my way, and we'll be fine.

voices.title: About Us: Greetings
voices.text: Don't be offended if you try to greet me on the street and I don't respond. It's simply because I'm wearing my soundproof earpieces, that's all.

voices.title: About Us: Helping Each Other
voices.text: It seems you're perfectly capable of taking care of yourself, so much so that you even look after that little companion of yours. I don't have any suggestions to offer you, and frankly, you probably don't need my help.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: To be completely honest, this Dendro Vision isn't of much help to my research... However, there's no denying the effectiveness of elemental powers when settling a physical dispute, so it still proves useful at times.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Truth serves no master. Humankind is not a vehicle for knowledge, nor is knowledge the aim of humankind.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: There are many things in this world that may catch our eye, but don't always believe what you see. If what we see in the world were all there was to it, then there'd be no need to think, would there?

voices.title: About Lesser Lord Kusanali
voices.text: One should neither dismiss nor overly revere the divine. Gods require followers, and they are also part of a biological hierarchy. That's why I don't take any pride in the fact that I helped rescue a god. I hope Lesser Lord Kusanali doesn't take offense.

voices.title: About Kaveh: Overly Sensitive
voices.text: Kaveh tends to be overly sensitive about everyone and everything he crosses paths with, and he's constantly making a fuss about nothing. Maybe it's because he's too emotionally fragile...

voices.title: About Kaveh: Getting Duped
voices.text: Someone set up a stand on the street saying that for each handmade keychain they sold, a child in poverty would be given a meal. Kaveh bought at least a dozen.\n...This is Sumeru, where even healthcare is free. I needn't say more.

voices.title: About Tighnari
voices.text: Apparently, a lot of people think he has a bad temperament, but I don't think they're giving him a fair chance. When Kaveh built a house right over a Withering Zone and created a huge mess, it ended up being a real headache for the Forest Rangers. Even so, this Forest Ranger didn't hold it against Kaveh. He even invited Kaveh to his house for a meal. Hmm, maybe it's good people like him who allow people like Kaveh to survive.

voices.title: About Dori
voices.text: She's sharp and always keeps an eye out for herself. She knows how to take life by the reins and make her dreams a reality. I'm not condoning her actions, but just because we stand on different sides doesn't mean that I can't appreciate her attitude towards life.

voices.title: About Cyno
voices.text: The hivemind case certainly added to the matra's workload, but my conscience is clear. The root cause of what ultimately transpired actually has nothing to do with me at all. I'm sure Cyno appreciates that, as he hasn't once approached me about the incident.

voices.title: About Nilou
voices.text: The strengths and weaknesses of a performing artist are quite clear. Nilou knows how to play to her strengths, which enables her to live a happy and simple life.

voices.title: About Dehya
voices.text: It's a waste for such a capable person to remain among the Eremites. If only she'd consider my suggestion to join the Akademiya... Our work would become a lot easier with someone like her around, but a predictable life isn't exactly her cup of tea — I can understand that. *sigh* What a pity.

voices.title: More About Alhaitham: I
voices.text: Most people are wary of interacting with me. Perhaps they're afraid, or maybe they think I'm difficult to get along with. I hope to keep things this way.

voices.title: More About Alhaitham: II
voices.text: I've never been interested in social interactions, and as you can see, my life is more comfortable than most. I'd say this is proof enough that being social is not one of life's necessities.

voices.title: More About Alhaitham: III
voices.text: Every person should have something that they believe in and hold on to from beginning to end. Otherwise, it's easy to succumb to the vicissitudes of life and find yourself being led astray.

voices.title: More About Alhaitham: IV
voices.text: Once order is disrupted, the consequences spread like wildfire. I'd like to avoid such a scenario, so I can keep my life intact and uninterrupted.

voices.title: More About Alhaitham: V
voices.text: I'll occasionally go to the tavern for a drink after work.\nThat's not what you needed to know about? Huh, I was under the impression that sharing what you do in your free time is more personal than telling someone your thoughts or opinions. After all, you can get those from anybody on the Message Board.

voices.title: Alhaitham's Hobbies
voices.text: I like reading difficult and abstruse books, and seeing others scratch their heads in confusion.\nI'm only joking. I don't delight in others' misery, and rarely do I encounter a book that's difficult for me.

voices.title: Alhaitham's Troubles
voices.text: Based on my observations, many people inflict trouble upon themselves. Life already has enough hardships — no need to add to them.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: Taste supersedes presentation, else you risk overcomplicating the purpose of food. I think this is simple enough to understand.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: It's difficult to eat soup-like dishes while reading.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Mmm, I can taste your mastery of the seasonings.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Hmm, a contemporary flavor. Not bad.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Let's not eat here. Mind if I... take it home?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy birthday. I've always thought people are a little too enthusiastic about celebrating the day they were born. Wouldn't it be better to apply all that enthusiasm towards their daily lives and improve their standards of living? But you seem to have done well for yourself. I didn't know what kind of gift to get, so I'll just set up a special application channel, reserved for your submissions alone.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Thank you.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Ah, so it wasn't a one-time-only thing.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: I think you're more excited than me about this progress.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: We mustn't let those lazy Akademiya scholars know about the progress I'm making. If they catch wind of this, they'll stop at nothing to make my life even more of a hassle. I'll reject anything they send my way, of course, but the communication required to do so is a huge waste of my time.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Here you are.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Flicker.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Hmph.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Scatter.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Diffract.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: A process of elimination.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Here you go.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Don't let any of it roll away now.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Huh.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: What a drag.

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: The plan's changed.

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: I need more time.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Allow me.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: As expected.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: I didn't... foresee this...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: I... miscalculated...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: A grave... oversight...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Tch, how bold.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: Well now...

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Yes?

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Let's get down to business.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: How long will this require, exactly?
